summary: legal checked in 5 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Risk disposition: BLOCKED for SearchWoot public beta or go-live; retain private, preview-only exposure. Woot documentation evidences API access and rate limits, but not rights to store, derive, cache, publicly display, alert on, or monetize deal data. Public terms point against those uses. Compliance is a technical baseline, not legal certification. Security, accuracy/freshness, measurement, analytics, and owner gates remain incomplete. Ordinary reversible growth may continue only when it adds no new data collection, credentials, permissions, dependencies, cross-site behavior, unsupported claims, or disclosure/provenance risk.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active. No SearchWoot task is closed because the snapshot provides no new direct evidence satisfying any open deliverable. Progress is limited to an existing rights packet, partial data-flow artifacts, and draft privacy/cookie/terms files. Next evidence actions are concrete: assemble the authoritative rights packet for owner-authorized human-counsel review without sending outreach; produce the read-only alert-data flow and retention table; capture deployed consent and GA4 configuration evidence without enabling tracking; and produce the operator/vendor log inventory with retention, access, incident, and request procedures.

Fleet compliance disposition: conditional for ordinary reversible growth, blocked for security-sensitive releases, gated public exposure, and unsupported monetization or claims. Compliance reports 37 passes, 16 fails, and 8 unknowns across 61 sites, with open banner, consent, reject, GA4, privacy, and terms findings; this is not certification. Analytics is unavailable for all expected sites and must remain unknown, not zero. Revenue evidence is limited to a 2026-09-21 provider window with $4.92 aggregate unattributed commission; no ROI, margin, forecast, or causal-lift claim is supported. Do not admit new implementation while capacity is 10/10; preserve existing readiness and repair work.

Maintain private and preview-only launch gates where rights, privacy, consent, disclosure, claims, provenance, security, attribution, or owner evidence remains incomplete. Continue existing evidence work only.

items.title: Maintain private launch gates and complete evidenced compliance work
items.summary: Keep SearchWoot private and preview-only; retain fleet and site-factory launch gates while rights, privacy, consent, disclosure, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, security, accuracy, measurement, and owner evidence remain incomplete.
items.requested_action: Continue the existing read-only launch-readiness workstream without duplicate telemetry, outreach, deployment, credentials, spend, or configuration changes. Do not close any launch task without direct evidence. Preserve ordinary reversible growth only within existing consent, disclosure, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and age-sensitive boundaries.
